subject.title: fix(media): make wake-false direct fallback reason-aware

question: Is the internal-path Mantis result plus scheduler matrix sufficient proof for this PR, or should merge wait for a live injected gateway/Telegram artifact that shows the fallback delivering exactly once?
rationale: The code path is internal and the current Mantis lane reports it cannot expose the condition through a normal Telegram Desktop interaction, so automation cannot decide the acceptable proof bar.

options.title: Require Live Injected Proof
options.body: Keep the PR paused until a proof hook or stack shows baseline missing or blocking generated media and the candidate delivering exactly one result.

options.title: Accept Scheduler Boundary Proof
options.body: A maintainer can accept the mocked scheduler matrix and internal fixed marker as sufficient for this hard-to-trigger path while owning the remaining live-delivery uncertainty.

options.title: Coordinate Through Proof Stack
options.body: Use the open proof stack to capture the combined evidence, then land this implementation separately if the artifact succeeds.

recommendation.title: Require Live Injected Proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR paused until a proof hook or stack shows baseline missing or blocking generated media and the candidate delivering exactly one result.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent route and account-bound delivery work makes this the strongest available owner signal for the proof-sufficiency decision.
